name: Refactor NfCli/NfExtension to use NfProgram with ICommand
summary: Transition from imperative command decoration (mutating commander objects) to a declarative, schema-driven architecture that is facet-agnostic.

rawActions.name: Define ICommand interface for Command
rawActions.statusNote: ICommand interface defined in nf-program.ts; Command satisfies ICommand structurally; NfProgram uses protected readonly cmdDelegate: ICommand

rawActions.name: Implement NfProgram builder
rawActions.summary: Create the NfProgram class that consumes ICommand to build and configure a commander.js instance, acting as the orchestrator for both domain logic (World) and command structure (ICommand).
rawActions.statusNote: NfProgram orchestrator: protected world, protected cmdDelegate: ICommand; constructor pattern established; SetCommand interim usage tested

rawActions.name: Have NfCli extend NfProgram
rawActions.summary: NfCli constructor passes new Command() to NfProgram; eliminates interim new NfProgram() calls in command handlers
rawActions.statusNote: NfCli extends NfProgram; config centralized; 692/727 tests passing; 35 failures in CLI tests due to process.exit in command execution context

rawActions.name: NfProgram world accessor
rawActions.summary: should throw an  error if world has not been initialized. this allows commands to simply 'const { world } = nfProgram' instead of error checking themselves
rawActions.statusNote: World accessor implemented as getter; throws if uninitialized; test updated to verify throw behavior
